responseModel: y(c)=B+sum_i L_i c_i+c^T F c, for c=(v_u,v_d,a_2)

factorialDesign.explanation: The union of the three coordinate planes contains 19 settings: one origin, six signed axes and twelve signed pair corners. It identifies B, three linear terms and the six independent entries of symmetric F. The eight all-nonzero corners are held out to test the quadratic/no-three-way model.
factorialDesign.pairFormula: Fij=[y(+,+,0)-y(+,-,0)-y(-,+,0)+y(-,-,0)]/8, with the unused coordinate set to zero

positivity.determinantFormula: Fuu Fdd Faa+2 Fud Fua Fda-Fuu Fda^2-Fdd Fua^2-Faa Fud^2

fermionEdge.source: Arias-Aragon et al., Production of Thermal Axions across the ElectroWeak Phase Transition, arXiv:2012.04736
fermionEdge.admittedStatement: The published broken-phase analytic cross sections for t anti-b -> W+ a and crossed t W- -> b a / b W+ -> t a retain independent c_t and c_b dependence, including mixed c_t c_b terms.
fermionEdge.limit: The paper uses the amplitudes for thermal production and switches on operator families separately in its cosmological presentation; it is not a collider likelihood or a three-source response table.

topWeakTopology.source: Hosseini and Mohammadi Najafabadi, Exploring Axion-Like Particle Couplings through Single Top tW-Channel and Top Pair Production at the LHC, arXiv:2408.11588
topWeakTopology.admittedStatement: Associated t W a production contains top-like and W-emission topologies in one final-state family.
topWeakTopology.limit: The published analysis does not provide the signed bottom/top/W three-coefficient kernel; topology alone does not establish surviving pairwise interference.

amplitudeFamily: t -> b W+ a (crossed, where kinematically open)
oneFamilyCandidate.exactStatus: The c_t-c_b edge is source-native in the fermionic broken-phase calculation. A joint c_t-c_b-c_W amplitude and all three interference entries have not been published or computed here.
oneFamilyCandidate.requiredCalculation: Implement one gauge-consistent broken-phase model with independent signed c_t, c_b and c_W definitions; evaluate the 27 settings on common phase-space points; fit the 19 coordinate-plane settings and predict the eight all-nonzero settings before detector profiling.
killTests: any nominal edge vanishes after helicity, colour, CP and phase-space integration
gauge completion removes the apparent separation of the three coefficients
the 19-point fit fails any of the nine pair-plane closure residuals
the eight held-out corners reveal higher-order or implementation dependence
the fitted symmetric kernel violates a principal-minor or determinant positivity condition
detector and nuisance folding erase an edge needed for the triangle

interpretation.jordanJob: The completed symmetric response kernel asks whether all three self- and cross-responses can coexist inside one positive cone; its determinant is a global condition not supplied by the pairwise bounds alone.
interpretation.lieJob: Signed basis changes transport the three source directions by F -> S F S without changing the determinant or the cycle product.
interpretation.middle: One process family would make admission and transport refer to the same event record. It would reduce the cross-scale bridge from an identification necessity to an external validation route.
interpretation.nonClaim: This ordinary 3x3 positive response matrix is not evidence for a magical J3 algebra, E8, or a fundamental three-source law.

verdict.closed: A finite 27-setting protocol now extracts the full signed three-source quadratic kernel with 19 fit settings, nine internal pair-plane residuals and eight held-out three-source predictions. The determinant and cycle product are invariant under all eight node sign conventions.
verdict.newlyLocated: The published W-associated broken-phase axion amplitudes supply a source-native top-bottom interference edge in the same broad electroweak process family as the top/W topology.
verdict.open: No source-native c_t-c_b-c_W kernel, surviving bottom-W edge, detector-level triangle or signed map to the corpus five-coordinate basis has been computed.
verdict.nextCalculation: Generate the gauge-complete W-associated three-source amplitude and run the 27 settings. Only then decide whether the triangle exists; retain B_c decay as a low-energy validation arm rather than a necessary sign-identification bridge.
